title: Plot Points on y = 2x − 1
prompt: Drag three points onto the grid so that every one of them lies on y = 2x − 1, then press Check.
learning_objective: Recognise that the graph of y = mx + c is the set of exactly those points that satisfy the equation.

spec.title: Plot Points on y = 2x − 1
spec.instruction: The rule is y = 2x − 1. Drag each point onto a grid intersection where the rule is true, then press Check. The line is drawn once your points agree with the rule.

title: Two Points Fix the Line
prompt: Place the y-intercept and one other point that both lie on y = −2x + 8, then press Check.
learning_objective: Use the y-intercept and a second solution point to pin down a line.

spec.title: Two Points Fix the Line
spec.instruction: The rule is y = −2x + 8. One of your two points must sit at x = 0 (the y-intercept); the other can be any other point on the line. Then press Check.

title: Guess the Machine's Rule
prompt: Feed the machine several inputs, watch the outputs, then choose the rule that produced them.
learning_objective: Infer a linear rule from an input-output table and read it as y = mx + c.

spec.title: Guess the Machine's Rule
spec.instruction: Feed at least two inputs into the machine and watch the outputs appear in the table. Then choose the rule you think the machine is using and press Check.

title: Name the Slope and Intercept
prompt: Feed the machine, work out the slope and the y-intercept, and enter them as m and c.
learning_objective: Recover the slope and y-intercept of a linear model from observed input-output pairs.

spec.title: Name the Slope and Intercept
spec.instruction: Feed several inputs into the machine and study the table. Then type the slope m and the y-intercept c of the rule y = mx + c, and press Check.

title: Fractions on the Number Line
prompt: Place each fraction at the right spot on the line, then compare two of them.
learning_objective: Locate fractions by dividing the unit interval into equal parts, and compare them by position.

spec.title: Fractions on the Number Line
spec.instruction: The line runs from 0 to 2 and every unit is cut into eighths. Drag the marker to the value named in each task, then press Check.

tasks.why: 7/4 = 1.75, which is fourteen eighth-ticks from 0 — three quarter-ticks past 1.
5/8 = 0.625, five eighth-ticks past 0, just to the right of the halfway mark.

tasks.prompt: Place A at 3/4 and B at 5/8, then say which value is larger.
tasks.why: 3/4 = 0.75 and 5/8 = 0.625, so A sits to the right of B and A is the larger value.

title: Graphing Inequalities
concept: Graphing inequalities on the number line
prompt: Place the boundary of each inequality on the line and mark which way the solution runs.
learning_objective: Represent an inequality's boundary and direction on a number line, including open and closed endpoints.

spec.title: Graphing Inequalities
spec.instruction: Each task gives an inequality. Drag the boundary marker to the right value, choose the shading direction, then press Check. The line runs from −2 to 6 in halves.

tasks.why: x > 2.5 excludes 2.5 itself, so the endpoint is an open circle and the shading runs to the right.
x ≤ −1 includes −1, so the endpoint is a filled circle and the shading runs to the left.
−1 1/2 = −1.5, exactly one half-tick to the left of −1.

title: Solve 3x + 4 = 19
prompt: Use the balance to isolate x in 3x + 4 = 19, keeping both pans equal, then press Check.
learning_objective: Solve a two-step linear equation by subtracting a constant and dividing by a coefficient on both sides.

spec.title: Solve 3x + 4 = 19
spec.instruction: The scale shows 3x + 4 on the left and 19 on the right. Remove blocks from both pans equally, then divide both pans by the same number, until x stands alone. Keep the scale level and press Check.

title: Solve 2x + 7 = 15
prompt: Solve 2x + 7 = 15 by making the same move on both pans, then press Check.
learning_objective: Understand that each balanced move produces an equivalent equation with the same solution.

spec.title: Solve 2x + 7 = 15
spec.instruction: The scale shows 2x + 7 on the left and 15 on the right. Every move you make to one pan you must also make to the other, so the scale stays level. Isolate x and press Check.
